research_brief.central_hypothesis: A conditional shared latent-state model with explicit delay and geometry moderators predicts held-out collective-motion observables as well as domain-specific models within a preregistered practical margin.
alternative_explanations: apparent transfer is caused by measurement preprocessing
polarization or density alone explains performance
shared variables are domain-specific proxies with no invariant semantics

acceptance_rule: M2 is labeled conditional-transfer supported only if it is non-inferior to M0 on a held-out domain, improves over M1, retains material support under ablation, and passes tracking/geometry sensitivity analyses.
